Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wB2-075) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim backend was run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's GymnasiumDriver/family-config shape cannot express this upstream. MoleculeEnvironment has no action_space or observation_space, reset() returns None, step() returns an Observation object instead of the Gymnasium five-tuple, and seed(Smiles) takes a SMILES string rather than an integer seed (gym_molecule/envs/molecule_env.py:38-85); a GymnasiumDriver derives the contract from spaces the clone does not define. The package is therefore a direct Driver over the clone's entry class (native gym_molecule.envs:MoleculeEnvironment) with the package fake. cap.world.seed.v1 is deliberately not bound: the upstream seed method selects a start SMILES, not an RNG seed, so the class's integer seed input has no faithful mapping. cap.world.step.v1 takes the catalogue ticks plus an action object that mirrors the upstream Action fields action_c, pos and mol; cap.world.reset.v1 takes the class options object with an optional smiles start (passed to MoleculeEnvironment.seed) and returns seed 0 for the required class output because the environment has no RNG seed. The fake is a pure Python stand-in; it replaces RDKit's MolFromSmiles/MolToSmiles with plain SMILES string concatenation and was not compared with the upstream environment (RDKit, gym and Python 3.7.7 from environment.yml:7-15 were not run). NOT COVERED: rendering (render() returns a PIL image and cap.world.render.v1 needs an artifact store); the RDKit molecule parsing, canonicalisation and feature extraction; the Gymnasium action/observation spaces, reward, termination and info values, which the upstream does not define; and snapshot/restore (no get_state/set_state). Expected warning: G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because this simulated R0 driver declares no Limit on an actuating capability -- the class's ticks minimum/maximum are inherited from cap.world.step.v1 and enforced by the served schema (a refusal is INPUT_INVALID, not ENVELOPE_VIOLATION), so there is no safety envelope for SAFE-014 to probe. The earlier G8.NO_UNIT warning for ticks was cleared by declaring unit 1. There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes are bound, so there are no catalogue requests and no extension ids. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
